capability: Retain receiver-usable independent verification evidence, as an alternative to a repeatable regression procedure.
one: The receiver can audit substantive standalone/public-API repair distinctions from authentic retained observations with recoverable producer, current delivered-build correspondence, tested scope and actual object/time/event/removal results. A concise public final report, inline table, structured metadata, real logs and linked traces are equally valid. Complementary records can establish the result together: an ordinary engine trace may cover timing/arrivals while a scoped direct-call observation covers visual-only silence and instance independence. Enough context must distinguish actual observations from restated requirements. A raw script, extra index, particular hash syntax, exact instance-ID field or exhaustive test matrix is not mandatory.
half: Some authentic retained independent observations are useful, but a material distinction or its producer/build/tested-scope binding remains only generic PASS prose, candidate-owned bookkeeping or an unretained private observation. Identify the concrete gap. Do not withhold valid ordinary trace/report credit.
zero: No usable retained independent observation evidence, or only candidate-owned success/completion flags incapable of establishing the stated object/time/event distinctions.
equivalence: A sufficiently scoped public final answer or workbook can fully equal an index/log file. Original client actions and expected outcomes are available context but are specifications, not actual execution results. Authentic private history can establish that a delivered observation report is truthful; it cannot by itself make unreported/unshipped observations client-visible.
ownership: Preserve the frozen procedure leaf separately. The final receiver-verification capability is max(reusable-procedure completion, retained-result completion): evidence and a usable method are alternative ways to make verification usable, not two charges for the same missing harness. Historical independent testing remains credited. Do not regrade source counts, capture-model claims, nominal one-tick boundary notation or the already-owned world-heading/default-timing failures here. A correct test that exposes a remaining failure is still useful evidence.
source: User-authorized industry-default verifiable handover; supplied preview-delivery-validation/references/handover-evidence.md teaches producer, scope, validation and artifact association. No scoring for reading a skill or preferred document layout.
unknown: Unread or truncated critical evidence stays null, never business0. Complete empty delivery inventory proves no retained capability.
